detail: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (64-bit, Trixie) is flashed and running on the Pi 5 in the Argon ONE V3 bench case (Aug 31). Sep 1: full architecture review landed - spec rev 25, console v4.5, CAD rev 24 (internals re-laid-out), storage decided (v1 CPU-only, NVMe on the FFC), BOM re-priced to $429, mass corrected to ~1.2kg est. Next up: DSI LCD + camera preview on the bench, then the kiosk skeleton.
